headline: Colombia Launches Digital Sales Platform Support for 12,000 Entrepreneurs
summary: The Colombian government introduced an e-commerce onboarding initiative for 12,000 small businesses. The public-private partnership aims to expand online market reach for small merchants.
why: Digital commercial adoption programs support small-to-medium enterprise growth across South American markets.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: E-commerce onboarding initiatives expand market access for micro-enterprises.
